guides.definition: Parses a JSON string into nlohmann::json and leaves parse errors explicit. Project dependency only: add the nlohmann/json headers to a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: jsonText
parameters.description: String or string-view expression containing JSON text.

examples.title: Parse a small object
examples.explanation: json::parse validates the full input and throws parse_error for malformed JSON unless a non-throwing mode is selected.

guides.definition: Creates a nlohmann::json object from nested initializer lists. Project dependency only: add the nlohmann/json headers to a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

examples.title: Create a job document
examples.explanation: Pairs in the outer initializer list become object properties; nested lists can represent arrays or child objects.

guides.definition: Reads a typed JSON property and returns a default when it is absent. Project dependency only: add the nlohmann/json headers to a C++ project; the isolated snippet runner does not resolve external packages.

parameters.name: fallback
parameters.description: Value returned when the key is absent.

examples.title: Read an optional retry count
examples.explanation: value avoids an out_of_range exception for a missing key; its fallback type influences conversion of the result.
